script.problem: It has 37 words. A meaning is about 30 words at most.

terra.problem: ‘Whose parents have died’ suggests both parents, but the sources also include a child who has lost one parent. Also, an orphan may still have someone to protect them.
In John 14:18, Jesus uses ‘orphans’ figuratively for people left without care or protection. The meaning only describes children whose parents have died.
